title: McMoneagle tasked to remote view Mars a million years ago
summary: Jesse Michels tells of McMoneagle tasked to remote view Mars a million years ago, about 1980s (declassified) at Mars, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: psychic spy program and he was given this is now public and declassified he was given coordinates to remote view on Mars a million years in the past. Yes.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Joseph McMoneagle, a member of a US psychic spy programme in the 1980s, was given map coordinates and asked to "remote view" Mars, that is, to see it with his mind alone, as it was a million years ago. Michels says this tasking is now public and declassified. If so, it would mean the government was curious enough about ancient Mars to point its psychics at it.
